fieldValues.title: Persona-in-domain: a new method type linked to the domain by a package relation
fieldValues.decision_question: How is a persona placed in a domain without changing core?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's local planning session on 2026-10-11 (clerk#32), walked one decision at a time; awaiting the owner's ratification in a clerk session.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: A new method type persona-in-domain, a package relation in-domain, versus changes to the shared persona or to core.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Add method type persona-in-domain v1 (title, goals as a new list field, jobs, needs reused). It refines the shared persona (core relation) and is affirmed as a definition. Its domain is given by a NEW method relation com.semanticops.method/in-domain from persona-in-domain to the domain record, and clerk check-method checks exactly one in-domain edge (precedent: within-boundary).
fieldValues.rationale: It stays inside the method package, needs no core change, and keeps the shared persona reusable across domains.
